thread:
Eden (People Ops): FYI we've published a short procedural update to the handbook about verification for benefit eligibility changes (ID/photo + supporting doc). Please read and ack by end of next week.
Rafael (Benefits): The main change: all mid-cycle eligibility edits now require a scanned document (proof of qualifying life event) and employee ID verification. This helps with audit trails.
Juno (Recruiter): For new hires who sign offers during the window, can recruiting start the verification on day 1 to avoid payroll delays?
Rafael (Benefits): Yes. Recruiting should upload the provisional docs into the HR intake portal and tag "pending-verify". Benefits will complete the verification within 2 business days.
Priya (Finance): Note: Finance will hold retro reimbursements until verification is complete. Please include the HR intake ID in expense claims to speed matching.
Eden (People Ops): We've added an example checklist and a small template for managers to confirm QLEs in the handbook page.
Juno (Recruiter): Where should I find the intake portal link? I couldn't find it in the new section.
Eden (People Ops): Link in the doc: https://handbook.redwood.com/peopleops/eligibility-verification. Portal: https://hr.redwood.com/intake
ack-bot: Reminder: handbook ack required for all full-time employees. Deadline: 2026-09-15.
Rafael (Benefits): Process tip: for domestic partner documentation, we accept affidavit + utility bill. International cases: attach passport + local civil doc. If uncertain, tag benefits.
Priya (Finance): We'll include a flag in the monthly compliance export for "pending verification" so managers can see outstanding items.
Juno (Recruiter): I'll add a step in the offer pack checklist and notify hiring managers.
Eden (People Ops): We'll host a 20-min drop-in Thursday 11:30 PT to walk through examples. If you need EMEA/APAC times, reply here and we'll add another slot.
Rafael (Benefits): If managers need bulk verification for multiple conversions, submit a CSV to benefits@redwood.com with employee IDs and docs.
Eden (People Ops): Thanks team. Final note: failure to ack will trigger manager nudges after 7 days; training link for managers added in the handbook.
